title: Cocycle identity for the iterated Weil isomorphism
statement:
Let $(K,\varphi)\in D^b_{ctf,\mathrm W}(X,A)$ be a
strict Weil complex under the
conventions of [def-trf-strict-weil-complex], with
$g_\gamma=g_X$ the
geometric-Frobenius automorphism
of [def-trf-scheme-frobenius], and let

$$
\varphi^{[m]}:Lg_\gamma^{m*}K\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }K
\qquad(m\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1})
$$

be the iterated Weil isomorphism
of [def-trf-iterated-weil-map]. Then for all
$m,n\in\mathbf Z_{\geq1}$ the identity

$$
\varphi^{[m+n]}=\varphi^{[m]}\circ Lg_\gamma^{m*}\varphi^{[n]}
$$

holds after the canonical pullback identifications
$Lg_\gamma^{m*}Lg_\gamma^{n*}K\cong L(g_\gamma^m\circ g_\gamma^n)^*K=Lg_\gamma^{m+n*}K$.

proof.text: By [def-trf-strict-weil-complex], $\varphi:Lg_\gamma^*K\to K$ is an isomorphism in the underlying derived category, and [def-trf-scheme-frobenius] makes $g=g_\gamma$ an automorphism of $X$. The finite coefficient convention in [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] gives the constant sheaf $A_X$. Its canonical coefficient maps are isomorphisms by [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map]. The compatibility of these identifications under composition is [lem-trf-constant-coefficient-composition]. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition] to pairs of powers of $g$ to obtain natural comparisons $L(g^{m+n})^*\cong L(g^m)^*L(g^n)^*$.

source.place: Tag 0D6D, lemma-derived-pullback-composition, with the explicit threefold coherence supplied by the auxiliary pro-etale comparison statement

proof.text: Put $F=Lg^*$. For positive $r$, identify $L(g^r)^*$ with the fixed iterate $F^r$ by successively splitting off one copy of $g$ using the preceding natural comparisons. The equality in [lem-trf-derived-pullback-coherence], applied to powers of $g$, says that splitting off two adjacent blocks in either order agrees. Induct on the number of factors in a block: a single factor is the defining comparison, and the induction step moves one split past the next using this three-block equality. Thus the comparisons for any two positive blocks agree with these identifications, including on morphisms by naturality. In the calculation below $F^0$ means the identity functor; no zero iterate of the Weil map is needed.

source.place: Proof paragraph 1, canonical pullback identification and its naturality; three-block associativity extracted as a separate node

proof.text:
For $i\geq0$ put

$$
a_i=F^i(\varphi):F^{i+1}K\longrightarrow F^iK.
$$

The definition [def-trf-iterated-weil-map] gives $\varphi^{[r]}=a_0\circ\cdots\circ a_{r-1}$ for every $r\geq1$ (a single factor when $r=1$). Functoriality of $F^m$ gives

$$
F^m(\varphi^{[n]})
=F^m(a_0)\circ\cdots\circ F^m(a_{n-1})
=a_m\circ\cdots\circ a_{m+n-1},
$$

since $F^m(F^j(\varphi))=F^{m+j}(\varphi)$ for $0\leq j<n$. The naturality and associativity established in steps 1 and 2 justify precisely these power identifications on each factor. Thus associativity of composition gives

$$
\varphi^{[m]}\circ Lg_\gamma^{m*}\varphi^{[n]}
=(a_0\circ\cdots\circ a_{m-1})\circ(a_m\circ\cdots\circ a_{m+n-1})
=a_0\circ\cdots\circ a_{m+n-1}
=\varphi^{[m+n]}.
$$

Every factor has the displayed source and target; in particular the last arrow toward $K$ is $a_0=\varphi:FK\to K$.

lean.statement: theorem iterated_weil_cocycle (T : TraceFormulaCoefficientConventions.{u}) (K : T.strictWeilComplex) (m n : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hn : 1 ≤ n) : (T.iteratedWeilIsomorphism K (m + n) (by omega)).hom = (eqToIso (congrArg (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback T.coefficientRing) (by simpa [Nat.add_comm] using (pow_add (End.of (T.datum.geometricGaloisFrobenius T.X₀)) n m))) ≪≫ (proEtaleConstantRingPullbackComposition ((End.of (T.datum.geometricGaloisFrobenius T.X₀)) ^ m) ((End.of (T.datum.geometricGaloisFrobenius T.X₀)) ^ n) T.coefficientRing).symm).hom.app K.obj.carrier ≫ (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback T.coefficientRing ((End.of (T.datum.geometricGaloisFrobenius T.X₀)) ^ m)).map (T.iteratedWeilIsomorphism K n hn).hom ≫ (T.iteratedWeilIsomorphism K m hm).hom
